script_text: Taurus, this week love and money collide in ways you absolutely won't see coming. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun lights your 8th House of shared resources, forcing hidden debts and buried feelings into the open. On Tuesday, Mercury trines Jupiter, sharpening your negotiation power — ask for the raise you've earned. Wednesday is the turning point: Venus, your ruling planet, leaves Sagittarius and enters Capricorn, your 10th House of career, blending romance with ambition. Thursday through the weekend, Jupiter in Leo expands your 2nd House of income, but Friday's Moon square Mars in your 5th House sparks impulsive spending. As an earth sign, you crave security, so tie every promise to paper. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 10th House. Friday is your riskiest day because the Moon squares Mars in the 5th. One tip: sign nothing before Sunday night. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
